jobs.title: Financial Investigator / Litigation Financial Analyst Supporting the National Fraud Enforcement Division
jobs.description:
Be a part of the nationwide law enforcement initiative that removes the tools of crime from criminal organizations, depriving wrongdoers of proceeds from their crime and impacting the infrastructure of criminal enterprises.

FSA Federal (FSA) is focused on delivering unsurpassed services in support of law enforcement and homeland security. We currently have a vacancy for a Litigation Financial Analyst. In this role, you will be supporting the overall mission of the National Fraud Enforcement Division. If you are looking for a meaningful, mission driven career, Join FSA!

**Responsibilities**

* Assisting at all levels in the development of probable cause to support applications for seizure warrants and civil and criminal forfeitures, beginning at the investigation level through to disposal of assets.
* Working closely with attorneys in preparation and filings of court documents, electronically and in-person.
* Conducting first-level document review, and culling documents/evidence for attorney review.
* Conduct various document/evidence searches using document management databases, such as Relativity.
* Create and manipulate spreadsheets.
* Assist prosecutors in reviewing and analyzing financial records obtained during investigations to determine the source and flow of funds, the nature and volume of transactions conducted, and the interplay among related accounts.
* Trace criminal proceeds, identify forfeitable assets and funds, and develop legal theories for forfeiture.
* Assist prosecutors with the financial component of their preparation for hearings, court proceedings, and depositions.
* Prepare exhibits, graphs, charts, and summaries to assist prosecutors in the effective presentation of financial evidence in hearings, court proceedings, and depositions.
* Assist the investigation by providing guidance relative to complex financial assets.
* Identify potential issues, perform technical and factual research, and recommends alternative solutions.

jobs.title: Technical Buyer
jobs.description:
Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable.

Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud-seeding science with weather-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities.

Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you.

The Vehicle team builds the aircraft at the heart of Rainmaker’s cloud seeding operations. We design, build, and fly autonomous drones that go where other systems won’t. Our aircraft fly into icing, turbulence, high winds, and low visibility, because that’s where the clouds worth seeding are.

We own the full flight system end to end:

* UAS: airframe, propulsion, avionics, and the autonomy that keeps our aircraft flying safely and reliably in severe weather.
* Dispersion payload: the hardware that delivers seeding material precisely, at the right place and time inside a cloud.
* Sensing systems: onboard instruments that measure the atmosphere around the aircraft, so we can see conditions as they happen and show what each mission accomplished.

We’re a small, hands-on team that takes hardware from first sketch to field deployment. Engineers here design a part, test it on the bench, and watch it fly in conditions most drone programs would ground for. If you like hard problems where the environment fights back, and you want your work to put water on the ground, you’ll fit in here.

### **About the Role**

As our Technical Buyer, you’ll own purchases from request through delivery, finding suppliers, keeping orders moving, and resolving issues before they slow development or production and turn engineering plans into real hardware. You’ll work directly with engineering, production, logistics and inventory teams to get the right parts where they need to be, when they need to be there. You will own the Manufacturing procurement program while remaining hands-on and bring impact on how quickly we build, test and deliver.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own purchasing from request to delivery by turning requests into accurate, timely orders and them through receipt.
* Keep the development and production moving by following up with suppliers and internal teams to identify delays and drive issues to resolution.
* Find the right supplies to source parts and manufacturing services balancing technical requirements, availability, cost and lead time and build a reliable supplier network by identifying, evaluating and building a database of qualified vendors and their capabilities.
* Lead accurate inventory management and build processes to keep counts reliable that gives Engineering and Production teams visibility into accurate parts.
* Partner with production and vehicle teams to anticipate demand, confirm orders, and close gaps before parts become critical and be a crucial part of production planning.

### **What We're Looking For**

* 2+ years of relevant purchasing, procurement, or supply chain experience on a small, growing team in a fast-paced start up environment focused on hardware manufacturing.
* A degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering, with the technical foundation to understand part requirements and work closely with engineers.
* Strong organization and follow through, managing competing requests without losing track of the details.
* Comfort adapting as designs evolve, priorities shift, and new information becomes available.
* A resourceful, solution-oriented approach so that when a supplier or timeline falls through, you find practical alternatives and keep the right people informed.
* Clear communication and a sense of urgency, especially when an issue could affect a build or production schedule.

### **What Will Set You Apart**

* Experience purchasing electrical components, PCB fabrication, and assembly services.
* Familiarity with mechanical design manufacturing processes, including machining, sheet metal fabrication, anodizing, and bead blasting.
* Experience working directly with suppliers to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and improve delivery reliability.
* Proficiency in Excel and experience using NetSuite ERP.

### **What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days**

Daily purchasing is under control: you process most incoming requests each day, make outstanding items and next steps visible, and ensure that every request keeps moving with no open request going more than 48 hours without follow-up. Issues surface early because you promptly alert requesters to order problems, explain the impact, and take a whatever-it-takes, solutions-oriented approach to resolving them and driving clear next steps. Production planning also becomes more proactive as you regularly connect with engineering, production, and inventory teams to anticipate needs and get parts on order before they become blockers.

Supporting the people behind the mission

Making Earth more habitable is ambitious work. We want the people doing it to feel supported—in the work we share and the lives they’re building.

* A stake in what we build. Meaningful stock options and the opportunity to help shape Rainmaker as an early member of the team.
* Support for your health. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* An investment in your future. A 401(k) with employer matching to help you build long-term savings.
* Time to recharge. Unlimited PTO for rest, exploration, and the people and pursuits that matter to you.
* Time for a growing family. Pa

jobs.title: MRO Buyer
jobs.description:
The MRO Buyer is responsible for purchasing, managing, and maintaining Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) inventory to support efficient and uninterrupted manufacturing operations. This role oversees the procurement, receiving, storage, replenishment, and distribution of maintenance parts, tools, and supplies while ensuring inventory accuracy and cost-effective purchasing practices. Reporting to the Maintenance Manager, the MRO Buyer works closely with Maintenance, Production, vendors, and other departments to ensure critical parts and materials are available when needed. The position also supports maintenance work order administration, inventory system accuracy, and continuous improvement initiatives to optimize storeroom organization and equipment reliability.

**Essential Functions & Key Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------------

* Source and evaluate suppliers for maintenance parts, tools, and materials, obtaining competitive quotes and identifying opportunities to improve pricing, quality, and service.
* Negotiate purchasing terms, pricing, and delivery schedules with vendors to support cost-effective procurement.
* Create and manage purchase orders, ensuring accurate pricing, quantities, and expected delivery dates.
* Monitor outstanding purchase orders and follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of critical maintenance materials.
* Develop and maintain an organized and efficient MRO inventory system, optimizing storeroom layout, material accessibility, and space utilization.
* Receive, inspect, and verify incoming parts, materials, and tools against purchase orders before storing them in designated locations.
* Issue maintenance parts, materials, and tools while accurately recording inventory transactions and assigning costs to appropriate maintenance work orders.
* Establish and maintain inventory controls to ensure consistent documentation of parts and tools removed from maintenance storerooms.
* Conduct routine inventory spot checks, cycle counts, and annual inventory verification to maintain accurate stock levels.
* Maintain accurate records of inventory transactions, purchase orders, receipts, and material movements within the company's computerized inventory management system.
* Generate manual requisitions and purchase orders for maintenance parts not currently available in inventory.
* Coordinate the repair and return of damaged or repairable parts, ensuring repaired components are properly tracked and returned to inventory.
* Coordinate outside repair services for maintenance equipment, including forklifts, conveyors, and other manufacturing equipment as needed.
* Create and issue maintenance work orders for equipment repairs and inventory rebuilding activities.
* Maintain tool crib sign-out records and monitor compliance with established parts and tool checkout procedures.
* Complete and maintain maintenance documentation, including preventive maintenance records, work orders, TPM documentation, and required log sheets.
* Enter and update maintenance records, purchase order receipts, and inventory transactions within the JDE system.
* Coordinate with Maintenance and Production teams to identify material requirements, prioritize urgent needs, and support planned maintenance activities.
* Maintain maintenance storerooms, tool cribs, and work areas in accordance with established 6S standards.
* Process returns of incorrect or damaged materials and coordinate replacement shipments with suppliers.
* Ensure compliance with applicable plant safety, hygiene, environmental, and food safety requirements, including GMP, HACCP, BRC, FDA, and USDA standards.
* Report safety incidents and actively promote safe work practices throughout assigned areas.
* Identify opportunities to improve purchasing processes, inventory accuracy, storeroom organization, and maintenance material availability.

* Previous experience in MRO purchasing, procurement, inventory control, or maintenance parts management within a manufacturing environment.
* Mechanical or technical knowledge of manufacturing equipment, machine shops, and maintenance operations.
* Experience sourcing suppliers, negotiating pricing, and coordinating material deliveries.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, equipment blueprints, and parts manuals.

jobs.title: Buyer
jobs.description:
**Our values start with our people, join a team that values you!**

Bring your talents to Ross, our leading off-price retail chain with over 2,200 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. Our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high-quality brands and on-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. All while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.

As part of our team, you will experience:

* **Success**. Our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving
* **Career growth**. We develop industry leading talent because Ross grows when our people grow
* **Teamwork**. We work together to solve the hard problems and find the right solution
* **Our commitment to Diversity, Equality & Inclusion, and our community.** We celebrate the backgrounds, identities, and ideas of those who work and shop with us because our differences make us stronger. We strive to be a positive force in our community.

Our Corporate headquarters are in Dublin, CA, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in New York City, Los Angeles, and Boston, and 8 distribution centers nationwide. With 2025 revenues of $22.8 billion, we are a Fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.

### **About this opportunity...**

In the heart of the NY fashion district LA and Boston, our Buying Offices sit at the heart of our business. Our expert merchandising team sources top brands and trends globally, delivering unbeatable value to our customers. This area of our business is ideal for candidates who love the thrill of a great deal and are driven to grow their careers.

The Buyer position is a leadership role with direct fiscal accountability for a product category. Responsibilities include managing business financials, inventory, and product flow, and negotiating in the market while developing deep and meaningful vendor relationships. This role will be integral in developing Assistant Buyers on the team and helping grow the future talent in the company.

### **What you will do and what you will learn...**

* Management of the open to buy while maximizing product opportunities and overseeing adherence to company guidelines. Identify and exercise discretion to take calculated risks. Accountable for sales and margin performance.
* Oversee and perform on-going analysis and interpretation of key business issues. This includes learning and driving rack strategies by monitoring regional merchandise reports, managing speed of spending, anticipate shifts in market availability and controlling an Open-to-Buy through analysis.
* Learn from the best in the industry about our “off-price philosophy” and build a treasure hunt assortment, with the right balance of good, better, best customer in mind.
* Prioritize in-person shopping at Ross and the competition to identify opportunities and make recommendations with the customer in mind. Act upon findings to create actionable assortment decisions that maximize trends and opportunities.
* Develop long lasting trusted relationships that translate into business opportunities for Ross. This includes frequent in-person visits to showrooms, selecting product, and handling negotiations, either independently or in conjunction with their supervisor. Negotiate with the short and long term in mind with the vendor on purchases.
* Effectively negotiate packaway goods to offset additional costs of storing merchandise (e.g., additional dating, vendors holding merchandise etc.).
* Provide regular in-person training to motivate and develop their associates providing specific and balanced feedback.
* Display a sense of urgency in implementing solutions, managing time, and prioritizing work effectively to maximize time in the market.
* Manage, supervise, and oversee purchase order management and administration. This includes ensuring direct reports are: writing orders, changes, cancellations and necessary follow-up (both internally and externally) to ensure key shipments are delivered and processed.
* Show creativity in putting together a deal with the big picture / total rack in mind. Both recommend or take appropriate takes risks to drive the business.
* Embraces new systems and technologies that can best support and sustain the company growth and culture.

### **What you need to be successful...**

* Strong communication skills: You actively listen, ask clarifying questions, and demonstrate the ability to build relationships.
* Flexibility: You can pivot and are adaptable, and receptive to feedback.
* Results Driven: You are tenacious, and achievement focused. You can prioritize your work and deliver it with accuracy.
* Intellectually curious: You can analyze and draw conclusions, are a critical thinker, and see the big picture.
* Resilient: You are persistent and persuasive. You stay focused on your goals and find creative solutions to problems.
* Product focus: Product is the center of what we do…. you must have an enthusiasm for the retail business and the product and can interpret the technical aspects of merchandising.
* Analytical Mindset: Ability to extrapolate data to make sound business decisions with strong understanding and utilization of retail math and analysis.
* A bachelor’s degree, 3+ years prior buying experience, including vendor negotiation experience. Closeout experience is a plus.
* Open to travel deemed necessary to support specific buying responsibility.
* #LI-BK1

Our Associates are at the heart of everything we do and we're proud to offer a range of benefits that reflect how much we value their contributions. Here's a peek into what you can expect as an eligible Ross Associate:

* A broad range of affordable health insurance options & personal medical plan concierge  
  401(k) with employer match and Life insurance
* Ample PTO including accrued vacation, paid holidays, divers

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
The Compliance Analyst serves as the project compliance expert on a wide portfolio of Clark’s government-funded construction projects. The Compliance Analyst will work alongside a dedicated team of highly trained compliance professionals to ensure our projects meet their compliance objectives. This is an early-career role with potential for upward mobility within the Project Controls and Compliance department.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Protect the organization and our trade partners by strictly enforcing compliance with federal, state, and local prevailing wage laws, as well as union and PLA requirements
* Generate, certify, and submit all Clark craft employee Certified Payroll Reports (CPRs), as well as subcontractor CPRs, timely and accurately
* Manage all prevailing wage-related document collection and review for Clark and our trade partners
* Perform detailed cross-checks of payroll submissions against other project documents to ensure proper payment of wages to all craft workers
* Collaborate with both project team and corporate leadership on process improvements and issue resolution related to project compliance
* Assist with complex prevailing wage issues and/or investigations with third parties
* Maintain confidentiality and compliance with access around sensitive information
* Create economic opportunity within the communities we work by ensuring Clark and our trade partners meet all goals around worker utilization and small business subcontracting
* Quickly resolve all internal audit report findings
* Manage project start-up and close-out for compliance
* Perform other compliance-related duties as required
Travel required to one or more project sites locally  

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) preferred, or similar relevant work experience
* Highly motivated individual with strong organizational and time management skills
* Careful attention to detail and reliability of output
* Ability to learn quickly and work under pressure in a fast-paced team environment
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Familiarity with federal and state contracting, labor regulations, and FAR regulations is a plus
* Alignment to Clark Standards of Excellence: Self-motivated, results-oriented, adaptable, team player, accountable, ethical, innovative, resilient, builds relationships, builds people/teams and followership, sets direction and executes
Bilingual with Spanish language preferred  

  

The work environment and requirements described below are representative of those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.

  

**The Physical Side of the Role:** This is an active, hands-on role. You can expect to be on your feet frequently, navigating active job sites with uneven terrain, stairs, ladders, and hoists. The work is physically demanding and requires a full range of motion, including bending, kneeling, and reaching. You’ll need to be comfortable frequently lifting and carrying materials up to 25 pounds, and occasionally up to 50 pounds. This role requires the ability to communicate effectively, as well as visual acuity for reading plans and inspecting work. The role does include desk time in the office that may require prolonged periods of sitting for tasks like computer work, document review, and meetings.

  

**Your Work Environment:** You’ll spend a significant amount of your time on active construction sites, which means being adaptable to all kinds of weather and moderate to loud noise levels, and comfortable in elevated or confined work areas with moving mechanical equipment and with the fast-paced nature of a project in progress. You will also spend time in a typical office setting with moderate noise levels. Your safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to follow Clark Construction's safety policies and procedures, and all applicable laws, at all locations.

  

**Our High-Performing Culture:** This is a demanding, high-performance environment. We are looking for candidates who are energized by challenge, thrive under pressure, and are prepared to do what it takes to achieve exceptional results. Success in this role requires significant commitment, including flexibility to work extended hours, especially during critical project phases or client deadlines. Beyond regular working hours, there will be occasions where business needs require your attention, particularly for time-sensitive matters or emergencies. You are expected to monitor and respond to communications (phone calls, emails, text messages) as required to address these situations effectively. Your ability to manage these expectations and be responsive when critical issues arise is key to your success in this role and our collective success as a team.

**A Drug Free Workplace:** Clark promotes a drug-free workplace. A pre-employment drug “fitness for duty” screening is required, and the company conducts random quarterly drug “fitness for duty” tests.

  

*Clark offers a total compensation package that includes base salary, bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision benefits, paid time off, retirement/401k, and Company Contribution plan. Additional benefits include life insurance, commuter benefit, short & long term disability, fitness reimbursement, FSA, tuition reimbursement, back-up daycare, tutoring & family support benefits, EAP/Work-Life assistance, and a holiday contribution program. For this role the base salary range is $70,500-85,000. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. Base pay is one part of the Total Compensation Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.* *https://www.clarkconstruction.com/careers/clark-experience*

Join America’s first, foremost, and finest and take your career to new heights.

**Role Purpose Statement**
--------------------------

The plays a vital role in supporting an efficient and reliable supply chain by sourcing, purchasing, and managing assigned categories of goods and services. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining strong supplier relationships while ensuring the timely availability of products needed to support daily operations.

Key responsibilities include procuring produce, frozen foods, and other food-related commodities, monitoring inventory levels, and managing expired or obsolete inventory to minimize waste, control costs, and maximize operational efficiency.

Working closely with internal stakeholders, vendors, and Customer Service Center teams, the Buyer helps drive supply chain performance by ensuring product availability, maintaining cost-effective purchasing practices, and supporting the delivery of exceptional service to both internal and external customers. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound decision-making, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

**Main Accountabilities**

* Conduct market research on products, suppliers, and pricing to identify sources that meet customer specifications, quality standards, and business requirements.
* Monitor product costs and market trends, proactively recommending solutions to mitigate the impact of price fluctuations.
* Strategically source food ingredients and products to achieve the optimal balance of cost, quality, and availability while meeting customer and Retail Sales requirements.
* Coordinate purchasing activities with vendors, including pricing updates, order cancellations, discontinued items, approved substitutions, backorders, delivery schedule changes, and invoice discrepancy resolution.
* Prepare, analyze, and maintain ingredient costing throughout the menu development process, incorporating supplier cost revisions as needed.
* Leverage knowledge of product availability, supplier capabilities, and industry innovations to recommend standardized products and value-driven solutions to customers.
* Support customer projects by ensuring purchases align with negotiated pricing agreements and established sourcing strategies.
* Assist with menu presentation preparation, including ordering product samples, confirming receipt, and collaborating with Category Managers to validate ingredient and packaging costs.
* Partner with Program Management and Pricing teams to ensure sourced products meet customer specifications and program requirements.
* Establish and maintain new product records within distribution and internal LSG systems.
* Collaborate with Customer Service Centers (CSC) to minimize dead stock inventory through resale opportunities, inventory transfers, or salvage solutions.
* Negotiate supplier agreements, evaluate vendor quotations, and ensure competitive pricing and product specifications through strategic sourcing and supplier benchmarking.
* Support Quality Assurance initiatives by collecting and maintaining product specifications, nutritional information, and related documentation.

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**
------------------------------------

1 to 3 years of purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or related experience required

Strong multitasking, prioritization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced setting  
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and support informed business decisions  
Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization

Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and a commitment to accuracy

* **Report on Findings:** Use Excel to extract, analyze, and summarize audit results, error rates, and variance trends. Prepare monthly and quarterly audit reports for the Pharmacy Compliance Analyst and maintain copies for compliance and audit purposes.

jobs.title: Financial Reporting Analyst
jobs.description:
Based in Pasadena, California, Dine Brands Global, Inc. (NYSE: DIN), through its subsidiaries and franchisees, supports and operates restaurants under the Applebee’s Neighborhood Grill + Bar®, IHOP®, and Fuzzy’s Taco Shop® brands. As of December 28, 2025, these three brands consisted of over 3,500 restaurants across 20 international markets. Dine Brands is one of the largest full-service restaurant companies in the world and in 2022 expanded into the Fast Casual segment. For more information on Dine Brands, visit the Company’s website located at www.dinebrands.com.

Job Location Type

Hybrid





**The Role:**

This role reports to the Manager, SEC Reporting & Technical Accounting, and supports the preparation, accuracy, and execution of:

* All public consolidated financial statement filings (Forms 10-K and 10-Q)
* The financial data included within the Company’s earnings releases
* Subsidiary entity financial statements and critical internal financial reports
* High-impact ad hoc finance initiatives that support our business operations

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Support and take ownership of assigned aspects of the timely and accurate preparation, review, and filing of external financial reports (Forms 10-K and 10-Q), ensuring strict compliance with SEC regulations and US GAAP
* Prepare and support the drafting of financial statement disclosures, footnotes, and Management’s Discussion and Analysis (MD&A), while maintaining comprehensive supporting documentation
* Monitor new requirements from the FASB and SEC
* Liaise with external and internal audit teams to ensure timely submissions of audit requests
* Support financial data collection pipelines to ensure data accuracy, reconciliation, and audit readiness
* Contribute to a collaborative team environment built on high operational standards and best practices
* Target salary $90k-$100k depending on experience

**Required Qualifications**:

* Experience: Minimum of two years of public accounting experience with a Big 4 or national accounting firm
* Technical Knowledge: Understanding of US GAAP, SEC regulations, financial statement mechanics, and SOX internal controls
* Systems & Software: Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)
* Capabilities: Effective analytical and technical research skills combined with proactive problem-solving
* Communication: Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Organization: Effective time and energy management skills, with a proven ability to consistently meet deadlines
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related business discipline
* Certification: Certified Public Accountant (CPA) required; active status preferred

jobs.title: Men’s Buyer & Special Make Up Manager (HQ)
jobs.description:
Buck Mason is seeking a highly knowledgeable and product-driven Buying & Special Make Up Manager to lead the discovery, curation, development, and execution of an exceptional assortment of products from some of the world's most respected brands, manufacturers, and independent makers.

This role sits at the intersection of buying, merchandising, product development, and wholesale operations, requiring both a discerning eye for exceptional product and the operational expertise to bring it successfully to market.

Beyond curating existing products, this individual will identify opportunities to develop limited-edition collaborations, and proprietary products with world-class partners and manufacturers.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable discovering an exceptional product in a small Japanese workshop, negotiating with a European heritage manufacturer, and managing the details of purchase orders, production schedules, and retail deliveries.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Buying & Product Discovery**

* Identify, research, and establish relationships with exceptional brands, independent makers, heritage manufacturers, and specialty suppliers across the United States, Japan, and Europe.
* Curate a distinctive assortment of third-party products that complements Buck Mason's aesthetic, product philosophy, and customer.
* Develop a deep understanding of the history, craftsmanship, manufacturing techniques, and cultural significance behind the products and brands represented.
* Attend international trade shows, visit factories and workshops, and maintain an active network of manufacturers, distributors, designers, and industry specialists.
* Develop seasonal buying strategies, assortment plans, and inventory investments that balance product discovery with financial performance.
* Negotiate wholesale pricing, minimum order quantities, payment terms, exclusivity arrangements, and delivery schedules.

**Special Make Ups & Product Development**

* Identify opportunities to create exclusive products and special make ups with established brands and specialist manufacturers.
* Collaborate directly with makers to develop unique materials, colors, finishes, patterns, constructions, and product specifications.
* Manage the development process from initial concept and design brief through sampling, costing, approvals, production, and delivery.

* Own the operational execution of third-party wholesale purchases and SMU programs, from purchase order creation through final delivery.
* Manage vendor communications, order confirmations, production timelines, shipping schedules, and delivery tracking.
* Coordinate with planning, finance, logistics, and distribution teams to ensure accurate and timely receipt of merchandise.
* Maintain accurate records of purchase orders, product information, vendor terms, pricing, and inventory commitments.
* Proactively resolve production delays, quality issues, shipping discrepancies, and other operational challenges.
* Establish scalable systems and processes to support a growing network of domestic and international suppliers.

**Merchandising & Commercial Performance**

* Develop a cohesive assortment strategy across product categories, price points, and seasonal deliveries.
* Partner with retail teams to ensure products are appropriately positioned, presented, and supported.
* Analyze sales performance, sell-through, inventory levels, gross margins, and customer response to inform future buying decisions.
* Identify opportunities for replenishment, exclusive distribution, and expanded collaborations with successful brand partners.
* Work with brand and creative teams to communicate the stories behind products, manufacturers, and collaborations.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* 6–8+ years of experience in buying, merchandising, product development, wholesale management, or a combination of these disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with American, Japanese, and European brands, manufacturers, and independent makers.
* An established network of industry relationships and a proven ability to discover and develop new supplier partnerships.
* Deep knowledge of heritage apparel, quality manufacturing, traditional craftsmanship, and specialty product categories.
* Experience developing special make ups, exclusive collaborations, private-label products, or limited-edition merchandise.
* Strong understanding of wholesale buying, product costing, margin management, assortment planning, and retail inventory economics.
* Hands-on experience managing international purchase orders, vendor relationships, production schedules, and import logistics.
* Strong negotiation, communication, organizational, and project management skills.
* Comfortable working with both small independent workshops and established international manufacturers.
* Proficiency with Excel, inventory management systems, and retail merchandising tools.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally.

jobs.title: Staff Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit's Global Business Solutions Group ("GBSG") is Intuit's largest business unit with $11B+ in revenue, serving 9M+ customers with the QuickBooks line of products including Accounting, Money, Workforce Solutions, and Live Expertise.

We play a critical role in supporting GBSG's strategy and execution by driving the financial planning process, consolidating results, forecasting, and managing the portfolio of offerings across GBSG. As the primary liaison for Corporate Finance, Investor Relations, and BizOps, our team ensures alignment and clarity in financial reporting and strategic decision-making.

Collaborating across the company, we serve as the central hub for delivering GBSG financial goals and shaping decisions that drive the future of the business. We are seeking a thoughtful and innovative problem solver with a passion for driving change and data to join our team and help transform how businesses operate globally.

**Responsibilities**

Responsibilities
----------------

* **Financial reporting**: Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting (e.g., month-end close packages, variance analyses) to provide transparency into the business's performance and key drivers. Consolidate global GBSG results across customers, revenue, and expenses, translating data into actionable insights that inform business performance and future implications for senior finance and business leaders.
* **Advanced analytics and modeling**: Leverage predictive modeling, advanced analytics, and causal inference methods to identify new opportunities to grow the business, exploring unit economics, market dynamics, product migration, cross-selling, product growth levers, and price/spend optimization.
* **End-to-end analysis**: Perform end-to-end analytics using advanced SQL, ML, and AI to extract business insights that drive tangible value for our customers and result in business growth.
* **Data visualization and automation**: Leverage data visualization and dashboarding tools such as Github and Tableau to uncover key business insights and improve team automation and self-service analytics.
* **Continuous innovation**: Keep up with evolving trends and advancements in data analytics and AI to drive innovation and continuously improve business processes.
* **Strategic planning**: Lead the strategic planning and forecasting processes across GBSG Finance, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives and financial goals. Partner with the leadership team, Corporate Finance, Biz Ops to develop and refine 1- and 3-year strategic plans, leveraging data-driven insights and business modeling expertise to identify risks, opportunities, and optimal investment strategies that drive sustainable growth.
* **Strategic framing:** Partner closely with members of the GBSG Finance team and SVP of GBSG Finance to develop executive presentations that connect our strategy to operational execution, delivering cohesive and actionable storylines for Investor Day, the Intuit Board of Directors, Senior Intuit Leadership, and Senior GBSG Leadership.

**Qualifications**

* BS in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related quantitative field; Master’s Degree preferred
* 6-8 years relevant experience in a highly dynamic finance role, with a proven track record of leveraging analytics to drive significant business impact.
* Highly motivated, self-starter with ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, simultaneously manage several priorities, and challenge the status quo to lead change and operational improvements.
* Attention to detail and ability to synthesize large volumes of data into insightful recommendations to the executive leadership team.
* Ability to influence all levels of leadership to drive actions, behaviors, decisions, and business outcomes.
* Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to rapidly construct impactful visualization, communicate insights and influence leadership
* Excellent collaboration skills, ability to work well within teams, and ability to coordinate across multiple organizations.
* Strong communicator with proven ability to synthesize data into clear, direct, and actionable senior executive deliverables (e.g., dashboards, presentations, etc.).
* Proficiency in SQL and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Qlik) with the ability to work directly with large datasets.

Preferred Additional Experience
-------------------------------

* High-level understanding of advanced statistical modeling and ML methodologies, such as causal inference techniques, with a strategic understanding of their application.
* Programming skills in Python or R; experience building ML and GenAI models, including automation and custom implementations.
* Experience with "big data" technologies (e.g., Redshift, Spark, Hive, BigQuery).
* Understanding of AI-native architectures and GenAI platforms; able to assess implications for data, testing, and behavior.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
  
Mountain View $154,000 - $208,500

jobs.description:

Under general direction, provides a wide variety of administrative, analytical, and workflow support to departmental activities and initiatives, including financial, performance goal management, systems, and human resources functions; analyzes programmatic practices and procedures and makes recommendations for organizational, operational, policy, and procedural improvements; conducts needs analyses, feasibility studies, and evaluations for assigned projects and programs; develops, summarizes, and maintains administrative and fiscal records; build collaborative working relationships among County departments and acts as liaison with various community, public, and regulatory agencies; and performs related work as required.

  

**Associate Management Analyst**: This is the journey-level and first level class in the Management Analyst series. Initially under close supervision, incumbents with basic professional administrative education and/or experience perform analytical and technical work within an assigned division/department. At this level, the impact of the decisions is moderate and the work typically involves interpreting, explaining, or gathering information.

  

**The ideal candidate will have:**

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop recommendations.
* Experience supporting project management, maintenance programs, or operational initiatives.
* Ability to develop workflows, procedures, and process improvements.
* Experience with budget development, financial analysis, procurement, and contract administration.
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate with staff, management, contractors, and external stakeholders.

**Examples Of Duties**
----------------------

**Duties may include, but are not limited to:**

* Analyze and support the Division’s maintenance needs through MaintStar, the Division’s computerized asset management system, including tracking and evaluating service requests, work orders, maintenance frequencies, and overall workflow effectiveness.
* Analyze and develop workflows within MaintStar’s Preventative Maintenance module to improve maintenance planning, tracking, and efficiency.
* Support and coordinate various Road Services Division maintenance programs, including the Sidewalk Identification and Notification Program, Drainage System Inspection Program, Culvert Inspection Program, and Local Road Safety Audit Program.
* Assist in developing and implementing an ongoing five-year maintenance program to support long-term infrastructure maintenance planning.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of the battery-powered hand tool program and identify opportunities to advance the Division’s zero-emissions goals.
* Support procurement and contracting activities, including developing Requests for Proposals (RFPs), preparing service agreements, evaluating proposals, participating in consultant selection processes, and assisting with agreement amendments.
* Assist in preparing Board reports and resolutions related to Division projects, programs, and contracting activities.
* Analyze financial data and assist the Deputy Director and Road Operations Manager with developing the Road Services Division’s annual budget.
* Assist in developing and documenting Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for Land Development Engineering and Encroachment Permit processes.
* Train front desk staff on sandbag reservations, evaluating service requests from unincorporated residents, and triaging calls to the appropriate agency or jurisdiction during emergency events.
* Assist in developing and implementing an Employee Recognition Program to highlight Road Maintenance staff contributions and recognize successful maintenance programs and initiatives.

**Qualifications**
------------------

***Knowledge of:***

* Project and/or program management, analytical processes, and report preparation techniques.
* Organizational and management practices as applied to the analysis, evaluation, development, and implementation of programs, policies, and procedures.
* Principles of mathematical and statistical computations.
* Research and reporting methods, techniques, and procedures.
* Modern office practices, methods, and computer equipment and applications related to the work.
* English usage, grammar, spelling, vocabulary, and punctuation.
* Applicable Federal, State, and local laws, regulatory codes, ordinances, and procedures relevant to assigned area of responsibility.
* Principles and practices of public administration as applied to operational unit and program administration.

jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our FP&A team. Reporting to the Finance Manager, FP&A, you’ll primarily own financial tracking and analysis for our hardware programs and R&D functions, working closely with Program Managers and R&D leadership. You’ll build and maintain program-level P&Ls and investment frameworks that inform strategic priorities, track budget vs. actuals, and surface cost variances in real time. * Identify opportunities to streamline and automate program and R&D financial reporting processes (e.g., templates, dashboards), enhancing efficiency and accuracy across monthly and quarterly deliverables
* Drive best practices in reporting and data utilization across the Program Management and R&D finance workflows.
* Prepare other ad hoc analysis and modeling as needed

This is a remote role open to candidates across the US, with a slight preference for those based in the Pacific time zone.

* 4-6 years of relevant finance experience, experience partnering with Product facing teams is a plus
* Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, working with planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, Pigment) preferred
* Established experience in FP&A or a similar analytical finance role, strong Accounting foundation, and a familiarity with annual planning, forecasting, and reporting

* Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new systems and tools
* High integrity, intellectual curiosity, self awareness, and a self starter attitude

* Experience in an opex-focused FP&A role

jobs.description:
About Us:

**Company Overview**

Unified Door & Hardware Group (UDHG) is a premier provider of commercial door, frame, and architectural hardware solutions serving customers across North America. UDHG supports a wide range of construction and architectural projects, delivering specialized expertise, professional installation, and reliable service to commercial, institutional, and multi-family markets.

As part of Foundation Building Materials (FBM), a leading construction materials distribution company, UDHG operates within a broader organization that combines scale, specialty expertise, and a customer-first mindset. Together, FBM and UDHG’s 8,000+ team members are committed to operational excellence, innovation, and employee development. As the organization continues to grow and evolve we are investing in strong, forward-thinking talent to support our long-term success.

Overview:

**Position Overview**

At Unified Door & Hardware Group (UDHG), the **Contract Administrator** is responsible for reviewing, evaluating, and negotiating customer contracts and related agreements. This role works closely with Sales, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and leadership to identify contractual concerns, understand the business impact of proposed terms, and recommend practical solutions that protect the company while supporting customer and business needs.

The Contract Analyst serves as a key resource throughout the contract review process, helping move agreements from initial review through negotiation and approval. This position requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate contract requirements in a clear and practical way. The Contract Analyst will handle negotiations within established guidelines and work with Legal and leadership when contract terms require additional review or approval.

Responsibilities and Qualifications:

**Key Responsibilities**

**Contract Review & Analysis**

* Review customer contracts, amendments, purchase terms, exhibits, statements of work, and other related documents.
* Identify contractual obligations, areas of concern, and terms that differ from company standards.
* Review provisions related to indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance, payment terms, warranties, confidentiality, termination, dispute resolution, compliance, and other key business terms.
* Evaluate how proposed contract requirements may affect the company financially, operationally, or commercially.
* Summarize key contract issues and provide clear recommendations for revisions, exceptions, or additional review.

**Contract Negotiation**

* Negotiate contract terms with customers and other external parties within established company guidelines and authority.
* Draft and propose contract revisions and alternative language that address company concerns while supporting the needs of the business.
* Work with customers and internal stakeholders to find practical solutions to contract issues and keep negotiations moving forward.
* Partner with Legal and leadership on complex or higher-level contract issues that fall outside established guidelines or require additional approval.
* Document negotiated changes, approved exceptions, and final agreed-upon terms.

**Cross-Functional Support**

* Work closely with Sales, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and leadership throughout the contract review and approval process.
* Participate in contract review meetings and clearly communicate contract concerns, recommendations, and outstanding issues.
* Help internal teams understand contract requirements and how specific terms may affect pricing, operations, project execution, or other business commitments.
* Communicate important contractual obligations to the teams responsible for carrying them out.
* Serve as a resource for questions related to contract terms, requirements, and the company's contract review process.

**Contract Management & Process Improvement**

* Support the contract review and approval process and ensure required approvals and exceptions are properly documented.
* Maintain organized and accurate records of contract versions, negotiations, approvals, and final terms.
* Help ensure contracts are reviewed consistently and in accordance with established company policies and guidelines.
* Identify recurring contract issues and recommend improvements to standard language, templates, and review processes.
* Assist with developing and maintaining contract guidelines, tools, and reference materials.
* Look for opportunities to make the contract review and approval process more efficient and consistent across the organization.

**Additional Responsibilities & Miscellaneous**

* Perform other duties as assigned to support departmental and corporate objectives

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Legal Studies, Finance, Risk Management, Supply Chain, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Three or more years of experience in contract review, contract management, contract negotiation, compliance, procurement, or a related area.
* Ability to read and understand contractual language and identify terms that could create financial, operational, or business concerns.
* Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills with the ability to balance company interests with practical business and customer needs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain contract language and concerns in a clear, straightforward manner.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies, obligations, and potential issues within complex contract documents.
* Ability to manage multiple contract reviews and priorities while meeting business deadlines.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain accurate contract documentation and records.
* Ability to work effectively with customers and with teams across Sales, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance,

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. **Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking an experienced Senior Financial Analyst to serve as a strategic financial partner across Finance, Operations, Procurement, Accounting, and Program Management. jobs.title: Associate Fiscal Analyst
jobs.description:
The Judicial Council of California is accepting applications for the position of Associate Fiscal Analyst with the Branch Accounting and Procurement office.

The Associate Fiscal Analyst, under the general direction of the Fiscal Supervisor, performs routine trust accounting responsibilities for up to four assigned non-complex courts and other unit activities. Assignments follow established procedures, internal controls, and required review and approval processes. The incumbent performs research, reconciliation, accounting and journal transactions preparation, and parks entries in the Phoenix system (SAP ERP). Additionally, the Associate Fiscal Analyst collaborates with unit Fiscal Analysts, the Senior Fiscal Analyst, the Fiscal Supervisor, and business partners to support accurate financial reporting, regulatory compliance, continuous process improvement, and efficient Trust Accounting unit operations.
  
  
**The Judicial Council**
  
The Judicial Council of California is the policy setting body for the state court system and has constitutionally conferred statewide rule-making authority. This authority includes developing, advocating for, and allocating the judicial branch budget. A majority of Council members are California state justices and judges; however, the Council also includes lawyers, legislators, and court administrators.

By enhancing its role as a leadership, knowledge, and service resource for the judicial branch, the Judicial Council’s staff organization seeks to continue to evolve as one of California’s most dynamic public service entities, focused on improving access to justice for all Californians by innovating and responding to the changing needs of the courts and the public. As a government body charged with improving the statewide administration of justice, the Judicial Council has multiple offices with diverse responsibilities relating to court policy and operations. As employees of the council, every member of staff should view and approach their work as one Judicial Council with a public service mission that is greater than the sum of its parts.

The Judicial Council strives for work-life balance, including substantial vacation and holiday time. In addition, we offer an excellent benefits package, including pension, medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending, up to $130 per month reimbursement for qualifying commuting costs, student loan forgiveness as part of Public Sector Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), and retirement savings plans. The San Francisco office is only a 7-minute walk from the downtown Civic Center BART station. In Sacramento, the office is located minutes from downtown, just north of Discovery Park.

The Judicial Council offers hybrid work arrangements for many positions. The successful candidate will be expected to work in person at the Judicial Council’s San Francisco or Sacramento office at least two days per week, based on their office leader’s direction, and reside in the areas surrounding these locations. To be eligible for Judicial Council employment and participation in the Judicial Council’s Hybrid Work Program, a prospective or current employee’s primary residence/remote work location must be in the State of California and within a 150-mile driving radius of their assigned reporting location.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Perform trust account reconciliations and monitoring for assigned non-complex courts and provide unit-wide reconciliation support. Identify and document discrepancies, escalating complex accounting issues to Fiscal Analysts, Senior Fiscal Analyst or Fiscal Supervisor.
* Prepare routine trust disbursements and related accounting entries in the Phoenix system (SAP ERP) in accordance with established procedures and internal controls. Refer disbursements involving reportable interest for Form 1099 reporting requirements to a Fiscal Analyst.
    
  o Review trust disbursement requests and supporting documents, calculate applicable interest on civil cases, and park the related accounting entries.

**Who We're Looking For** **- Senior FP&A Analyst**
---------------------------------------------------

Clearlink is looking for a Senior FP&A Analyst to be the finance owner for our Internet owned-and-operated (O&O) brands: HighSpeedInternet.com, CableTV.com, Reviews.org, WhistleOut and SatelliteInternet.com. These are some of Clearlink's largest brands. In this role, you'll directly shape where they go next.

You'll own the annual budget, rolling forecast and month-end story for the business unit. You'll also own the unit economics behind it: how clicks, leads and conversions turn into revenue, gross margin and profit by brand, channel and partner. This person turns that analysis into decisions. You'll flag risks and opportunities early, help teams decide what to prioritize, and see the work through to results.

This is a highly collaborative role. You'll work every day with Revenue Operations, and closely with Partner Strategy, Marketing and executive leadership. You'll present directly to executives. We want someone who is very analytical and strategic, and who will take the ball and run with it.

*Clearlink is a remote-friendly company, prioritizing virtual and in-person collaboration. This is a remote-first role for candidates who are located outside of Utah and outside of commuting distance. For candidates residing within 50 miles of our Salt Lake City, Utah office, a hybrid schedule of 2-3 days in-office is required.*

**The Impact You Will Make**
----------------------------

* **Annual budget:** Own and deliver the annual budget for the Internet O&O business unit. Build the driver-based plan, pressure-test assumptions with Rev Ops, Marketing and Partner Strategy, and walk leadership through the trade-offs.

* **Executive communication:** Turn complex analysis into clear, concise recommendations, and present them to executives and business leaders.
* **Cross-functional partnership:** Be the finance partner Rev Ops, Partner Strategy and Marketing go to. Work with them to plan, track and adjust performance, and follow through until decisions turn into results.
* **Tools and process:** Keep forecasting and reporting accurate, fast and scalable. Improve models, trackers and workflows in Abacum, Redshift, Excel and Google Sheets, and use AI tools like Claude to work smarter.

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

* **First 6 months:** Rev Ops, Partner Strategy and Marketing see you as their go-to finance partner. You've flagged at least one major risk or opportunity that changed a decision.
* **First 12 months:** You've delivered the BU's annual budget end to end. You've made a lasting improvement to how we forecast or report.

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Required**

* 4–6 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance or a related analytical role
* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related field
* Proven ownership of budgets and forecasts, including explaining variances and the drivers behind them

* Working SQL skills; you can pull and shape your own data
* Strong executive communication: you can turn analysis into a clear recommendation and present it with confidence
* A track record of strong cross-functional partnerships with non-finance teams

**How you work**

* **You take the ball and run with it.** You own outcomes, not tasks, and see work through to the end.

* **You speak up.** You flag risks and opportunities before you're asked, and help teams prioritize.

**Preferred**

* Scripting or automation experience (Python, Apps Script or similar)

**Perks That Set Us Apart**

jobs.title: Global Payroll Tax & Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position: Global Payroll Tax & Compliance Analyst**

**Location:** Remote

**Duration:** 03 Months; contract with possible extension

**Description:**

we are looking for an experienced **Global Payroll Tax & Compliance Analyst** to join our team and support our global payroll tax operations.

In this role, you will help ensure that client’s global payroll operations comply with applicable tax laws, statutory requirements, and internal policies across multiple jurisdictions.

As a subject matter expert in global payroll tax compliance, you will play a key role in supporting payroll tax filings, audits, reporting, vendor management, and process improvements. You will collaborate closely with internal payroll teams, external payroll providers, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant payroll operations worldwide.

**Qualifications & Experience**

We’re looking for someone who brings:

* 3+ years of experience in payroll tax and compliance, preferably within a multinational or global organization.
* Strong knowledge of global payroll tax regulations, with expertise in at least two major regions: North America, EMEA, or LATAM.
* Experience working with global payroll systems and third-party payroll providers.
* A solid understanding of payroll tax processes, reporting requirements, and statutory obligations across multiple jurisdictions.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex tax concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* A high level of integrity, confidentiality, and professional ethics.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Payroll Tax Compliance & Reporting**

* Monitor, analyze, and ensure compliance with global payroll tax laws and statutory regulations, including income tax, social security, and other applicable local taxes.
* Review and validate payroll tax filings prepared internally or by third-party providers to ensure accuracy and timely submission.
* Manage year-end payroll tax activities, including the preparation and issuance of applicable tax forms such as W-2, P60, T4, and other jurisdiction-specific forms.
* Support payroll tax registrations, deregistration’s, and updates to employer payroll tax accounts in collaboration with local authorities and external providers.

**2. Audit & Risk Management**

* Support internal and external payroll tax audits by coordinating documentation, responding to inquiries, and ensuring timely resolution of audit requests.
* Maintain accurate, organized, and audit-ready documentation for payroll tax processes, filings, and reconciliations.
* Identify potential compliance gaps, tax exposures, and operational risks, recommending corrective actions and process improvements.

**3. Vendor Management**

* Partner with third-party payroll providers and tax consultants to oversee service delivery and resolve payroll tax compliance matters.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure compliance with established service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Escalate and coordinate the resolution of complex payroll tax issues across multiple jurisdictions.

**4. Data Management & Technology**

* Utilize global payroll systems to extract, analyze, and validate payroll data for tax reporting and reconciliation purposes.
* Partner with IT and payroll technology teams to improve system functionality, reporting capabilities, and payroll tax compliance processes.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes through automation, improved controls, and data accuracy.

**5. Stakeholder Communication & Support**

* Provide guidance and subject matter expertise to internal stakeholders regarding global payroll tax implications related to employment decisions, international mobility, and compensation changes.
* Collaborate with internal payroll, HR, Finance, and Legal teams to address global payroll tax matters.
* Support the development and delivery of training, resources, and guidance to internal teams on payroll tax compliance requirements and best practices.

**Why This Role Matters**

As customer continues to expand its global footprint, maintaining accurate and compliant payroll tax operations is essential. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to global payroll compliance, strengthen internal controls, mitigate tax risks, and drive operational excellence across an evolving international business.

If you are detail-oriented, knowledgeable in global payroll tax regulations, and passionate about building efficient and compliant payroll operations, we encourage you to apply!

Pay: $34.00 - $40.00 per hour

Experience:

* Global Payroll Tax : 2 years (Required)
* Global Payroll Compliance : 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

**Position Title:** Pricing and Purchasing Analyst

**Department:** Accounting

**Location**: Remote

Installation Made Easy (“IME”) provides software and process management that enable retailers and contractors to offer installed home improvements to homeowners in a convenient, consistent, and affordable manner. IME senior management has over 100 years of retail management and home improvement industry experience.

The Pricing and Purchasing Analyst position is responsible for assisting in the setup of home improvement programs within IME’s software platform, as well as ongoing support and maintenance of existing programs. This Analyst will interact with all departments within the company, including Accounting, Software Development, Business Development, Project Management, Operations as well as with Executive Management. Additionally, the Analyst will have the potential to interact with Retailer and Manufacturer representatives and third-party vendors.

An ideal candidate for this role will be able be independently motivated, diligent with details, and precise in their work. The candidate must be able to work independently in a remote environment. Accuracy is a requirement, not an option. Furthermore, the candidate must have the ability to understand a process from beginning to end, ask questions, and think through obscure situations.

**Essential Functions:**

* Immerse one’s self in company’s proprietary enterprise software and gain understanding of downstream impact of pricing and promotions, including impact on end customers, accounting, vendor payment, and third-party integrations
* Review retail price and cost data provided by Fortune 50 retailers and home improvement contractors to ensure accuracy and completeness, including reasonability of retail and margins
  + Utilize strong excel skills and ability to manipulate large amounts of data accurately
  + Learn and understand each home improvement program / category to ensure ability to apply judgment and identify errors
* Enter and maintain retail price and cost data within enterprise software
  + Demonstrate understanding of impact of responsibilities and a sense of urgency in turn-around time for changes

  + Learn and understand the various intricacies of promotions to include type, financial participation, stacking, product and labor applicability and the configuration of each within the enterprise software
* Proactively inform other departments of promotions before effective dates through maintenance of promotion calendar and clearly and concisely written email communications
* Create and implement consistent processes for reviewing, entering, and maintaining pricing and promotions within enterprise software to include intake of requests, change log, and approvals
* Daily, initiate vendor product orders, cancellations, and make payment upon receipt of customer home improvement sale contracts
  + Ensure vendor pricing matches cost within enterprise software and research /escalate if there is a mismatch
  + Investigate order discrepancies and handle ordering questions/issues.
* Assist accounting department in the testing of new home improvement program / category setup within enterprise software
  + Identify issues, submit software development bug tickets, and shepherd to resolution

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
* High level attention to detail.
* Requires Skills for position
  + Detail Oriented – ensure all product SKUs are updated correctly
  + Urgency – understand the urgency of tasks given and the downstream impact of not acting accordingly to outstanding pricing issues/adjustments
  + Microsoft Excel - have medium to advance level of excel experience and ability to work with large amounts of data and be able to cross check information using sumifs, xlookups, etc.
  + Ownership – be able to take ownership of work completed
  + Perceptive – be perceptive of changes made and why they are made so you are a master of your area
  + Initiative – take initiative to research and resolve issues found
  + Motivation to Learn – always seek out instances to learn more about the company, our system, and programs to ensure pricing/product is completed correctly.

jobs.description:
**About us**  
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

**Our people**  
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

**Our impact**  
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

**Who You Are :**

HighLevel is seeking a Sr. FP&A Systems Analyst to join our Corporate FP&A team. This hands-on role will support the implementation, maintenance, and optimization of our financial planning system, Abacum, and help integrate financial and operational data to streamline reporting across the business.

You’ll play a key role in shaping how the Finance team operates by building efficient, automated processes that improve accuracy, visibility, and scalability. You will be driving forward the scaling of our financial processes, identifying opportunities to reduce manual effort, and empowering self-service reporting for management. The ideal candidate has experience working with modern FP&A or BI tools, enjoys solving data and system challenges, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

You will report to the Senior Director, Corporate FP&A and partner closely with FP&A, Accounting, People, and Data teams.

**What You Will Do :**

* Support configuration, maintenance, and enhancement of Abacum, including financial models, formulas, dimensions, mappings, and planning scenarios, ensuring the tool meets Finance’s planning, reporting, and forecasting needs.
* Integrate financial and operational data from key systems (e.g., NetSuite, Snowflake, HRIS, CRM, billing systems) to ensure accurate and automated data flows into Abacum
* Build and enhance reporting dashboards and planning templates within Abacum to support Finance and cross-functional teams with consistent, real-time insights
* Effectively lead the intake, coordination, and execution of multiple projects or requests from cross-functional stakeholders.
* Collaborate with FP&A and Accounting teams to align data definitions, assumptions, and reporting structures across systems
* Support the rollout of Abacum “spaces” and dashboards for business partners across the organization, ensuring data accuracy and ease of use
* Perform data validation and reconciliations between source systems, financial models, and reporting outputs; investigate discrepancies and work with the appropriate teams to resolve them.
* Test model and integration changes before rollout to confirm calculations, data accuracy, and downstream reporting.
* Document key workflows, integrations, and system processes to ensure long-term scalability and repeatability
* Identify and automate manual Finance workflows by leveraging system capabilities and integrations to reduce friction and improve efficiency
* Partner with Finance leadership to evaluate new features, enhancements, or integrations that improve system performance and user experience
* Provide training and support to FP&A and business users on system functionality, dashboards, and best practices

**What You Bring :**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in FP&A, Finance Systems, or related roles within a SaaS or technology company
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining financial models in FP&A tools, including formulas, dimensions, and planning scenarios (Abacum preferred; Pigment, Adaptive, or Anaplan also relevant).
* Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., Intacct, NetSuite) and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake)
* Basic understanding of system integrations, data flows, and financial planning processes (forecasting, budgeting, headcount planning, reporting)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail and data accuracy
* Experience working with BI or reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) is a plus
* Ability to translate business needs into clear system requirements and collaborate effectively with technical teams
* Strong organizational and communication skills; comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
* Curiosity, ownership mindset, and enthusiasm for improving financial systems and processes

The salary range for this position is **$103000 - $125000** annually.
